name: Rococo: Deluxe Edition

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after Collect Income of round 7

categories.label: Prestige gained during play
categories.hint: Prestige counter position on the track before final scoring.

categories.label: Remaining Livre (also tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Raw Livre left; converted below, kept as tiebreaker.

categories.label: Employee end-game bonuses
categories.hint: Sum of prestige from crown (blue velvet) Employee cards.

categories.label: Hall majorities
categories.hint: Sum of 1st/2nd-place points over the 5 Halls (2 players: 1st only).

categories.label: Fireworks majority
categories.hint: Most Fireworks Decorations: 7/6 pts, second 3/2 pts by board side (2 players: 1st only).

categories.label: Statues
categories.hint: 2 pts per different Garment colour (max 4) per Statue token; Garments cannot be reused across Statues.

categories.label: Trademark tokens scoring
categories.hint: Points printed on spaces with your Trademark tokens (Garments, Decorations, All Halls bonus); Fireworks Garments x2/x3.

notes: family: area-majority. Step order: 1 Livre conversion, 2 Employee bonuses + Queen's Favor, 3 Hall majorities (ties: most Garments on Master Guest spaces, then musician Decoration; unresolved tie = all full), 4 Fireworks majority, 5 assign Garments to Fireworks, 6 Statues, 7 Trademark tokens. Hall/Fireworks/Trademark values are printed on the board so entered as totals. Jewelry Box expansion bonuses can be added to employeeBonuses. Rulebook uses 'Prestige Points'.

sources.title: Rococo: Deluxe Rulebook (Eagle-Gryphon)
